heading: Helping hosts do what they do best.
intro: BLOOM partners with locally rooted organizations, called Civic Hosts, that can bring neighbors together across difference to work through hard choices on AI and turn them into proposals decision makers can’t ignore. We bring the rest:

items.label: Funding
items.title: Funding
items.desc: We help level the playing field by providing resources for engagement, research, communications, facilitation, and the work required to bring a whole community into the process.
items.alt: Residents filling a community forum in Cache County, Utah

items.label: Training + methods
items.title: Training + methods
items.desc: Running a good public process is a craft. Hosts receive training, tested methods, playbooks, coaching, peer learning, and access to researchers and practitioners.
items.alt: A facilitator organizing ideas on a wall of sticky notes at the Utah Solutions Forum

items.label: Digital tools
items.title: Digital tools
items.desc: CivicOS, our open-source software, helps communities combine in-person and digital participation, engage hundreds or thousands of people, and see clearly where people agree, where they differ, and what matters most.
items.alt: Delegates working at tables with laptops at the Utah Solutions Forum
